headline: China Shifts Property Bond Funding Direct to Housing Projects
summary: China is shifting corporate bond proceeds directly to specific residential projects, with three state-backed developers winning approvals for multi-billion-yuan bond issuances amid contracting home sales.
why: Beijing's real estate intervention strategies affect debt service capability and property completion rates across the country's embattled real estate market.

impacts.name: China Real Estate
impacts.why: Regulators approved project-tied bond issuances, targeting funding primarily to state-backed developers.
